purpose: Permit adaptive discovery only through an explicit, traceable direction-evidence track without pretending that skipped exploration occurred.
requiredEvidence: current local hashes or source digests
style-independent thesis and Design DNA contract

anchors.0: Discovery was skipped without a valid alternate evidence track.
anchors.1: A direction source exists but its provenance, currency, adoption, or contract is materially incomplete.
anchors.2: The selected track is mostly traceable but still has evidence or claim-boundary gaps.
anchors.3: The track is current, traceable, and translated into a feasible contract with minor limitations.
anchors.4: The track is fully current, hash-bound, truthfully adopted, contract-governed, independently reviewed, and responsive-proof ready.

checks.question: Is exactly one direction-evidence track declared?
checks.passCondition: The run declares exploratory-orientation, approved-visual-reference, direct-reference, or existing-system and records why it applies.

checks.question: When exploration is skipped, is the replacement evidence current and sufficient?
checks.passCondition: A direct reference is locally hash-bound and explicitly adopted, or the existing system has current source, screenshot, Design DNA, and contract evidence.
failureSignals: stale cache treated as current proof
existing styles assumed to be a qualified direction

checks.question: Does the run describe only the exploration it actually performed?
checks.passCondition: Direct-reference and existing-system tracks never claim competing-direction exploration; cache reuse never claims current rendered acceptance.
failureSignals: cached DNA presented as fresh screenshot evidence
automated plan presented as human approval

checks.question: Does the selected direction still produce a feasible contract and full final proof?
checks.passCondition: The thesis, signature relationship, asset/type plan, DESIGN.md contract, desktop/tablet/mobile final evidence, and independent semantic critic all pass.
failureSignals: style label used instead of a thesis

blockingRules: A faster profile never counts as evidence.
Skipping exploration requires a complete alternate evidence track.
Every track converges on the same full final acceptance contract.
